generated_evidence.quote_en: **Retrieval:** ACL filtering precedes generation text release; relevance never grants access. Form lexical/normalized vector queries, bound candidates, RRF merge, deterministic rerank, diversify documents/sources and cap model-context tokens. Internal search rows retain tenant/workspace/version/chunk/language/classification, normalized text and **1536-dimensional embeddings**. Parallel rebuilds atomically switch read alias only after completeness/recall checks; database remains authoritative. Cache keys include tenant, user-scope digest, source ACL revision, query hash and index generation. Permission change purges affected cache before TTL and next-query access remains mandatory. Insufficient quality/confidence returns `NO_SUPPORTED_EVIDENCE`, never fabricated context; clarification versus human route is unresolved. generated_evidence.quote_en: **Search:** Apply lexical and normalized vector retrieval, bounded candidates, reciprocal rank fusion, deterministic reranking, source diversity and per-query model-token budgets. Ranking is not authorization. Revoked source access must be effective **before next retrieval**, even while index cleanup is pending; source ACL changes invalidate affected cache before new results. Query fields, search placement, blank-query behavior, filtering and sorting remain open. If confidence/quality is insufficient, return `NO_SUPPORTED_EVIDENCE`, not fabricated context; clarification versus human routing needs a decision. Missing-citation generation has needs-review **or** unsupported outcome under TST-009, not a selected universal state. Policy-permitted nonessential PII redaction and default token/digest logs do not waive these prohibitions. Audit is independently retained, append-only/batch-hash chained; register SHA-256 source/revision does not select the chain algorithm. Diagnostic logs use **30-day default TTL**; security audit a separate **seven-year fictional policy**, with holds/receipts and corporate selection unresolved.
